verdict.rationale: Fern Agent automations can run on a schedule to review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, and analytics. They report back findings and open pull requests with suggested changes, which is AI-generated insight from the customer's own data inside the product. However, this comes from prompt-driven scheduled agent runs described mainly in changelog entries, not a built-in insights surface. Ask Fern also answers questions grounded in docs content with citations. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI insights/suggestions view over analytics, in-depth docs on the automation insight output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
